    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuthController
    RestController for handling authentication-related requests, such as registration, login, token refreshing, logout, and retrieving the current authenticated user.
    AuthResponse
    DTO for representing authentication response data.
    AuthService
    Service responsible for handling authentication-related operations.
    CustomUserDetailsService
    Custom implementation of UserDetailsService for managing user authentication.
    Event
    Represents an Event entity in the system.
    EventController
    Controller for handling event-related API endpoints.
    EventMapper
    Mapper interface for converting Event entities to EventSmallInfoResponse DTOs.

    Represents an event registration entity in the system.
    EventRepository
    Repository interface for managing Event entities in the database.
    EventService
    Service class for managing events.
    EventSmallInfoResponse
    DTO for transferring minimal event information.
    EventState
    Represents the state of an Event at a given point in time.
    EventStateList
    Represents a list of possible states for an Event.
    EventStateListMapper
    Mapper interface for converting EventStateList entities to EventStateListResponse DTOs.
    EventStateListRepository
    Repository interface for managing EventStateList entities in the database.
    EventStateListResponse
    DTO for representing event state information.
    EventTagMapper
    Mapper interface for converting EventTags entities to EventTagsResponse DTOs.
    EventTags
    Represents tags associated with events.
    EventTagsRepository
    Repository interface for managing EventTags entities in the database.
    EventTagsResponse
    DTO for representing information about event tags.

    JwtAuthenticationFilter is a custom Spring security filter responsible for handling JSON Web Token (JWT) based authentication within the application.
    JwtUtil
    A utility class for handling JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
